tools.name: fetch_link_preview
tools.description: Fetches a web page from a URL shared in a channel and returns its title, description, and preview image URL so the link can be displayed as a preview card.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the shared link to preview

tools.code:
import re
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("chat-workspace")


def _meta(html, prop):
    pattern = r'<meta[^>]+property=["\']og:%s["\'][^>]+content=["\']([^"\']*)["\']' % prop
    m = re.search(pattern, html, re.I)
    return m.group(1) if m else None


@mcp.tool()
def fetch_link_preview(url: str) -> dict:
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=10, allow_redirects=True)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    html = resp.text[:200000]
    title_match = re.search(r"<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>", html, re.I | re.S)
    title = _meta(html, "title") or (title_match.group(1).strip() if title_match else "")
    return {
        "url": resp.url,
        "title": title,
        "description": _meta(html, "description"),
        "image": _meta(html, "image"),
    }

import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _text(node, tag):
    child = node.find(tag)
    return child.text.strip() if child is not None and child.text else ""


@tool
def sync_channel_from_rss_feed(feed_url: str, limit: int = 5) -> list:
    req = urllib.request.Request(feed_url, headers={"User-Agent": "workspace-bot/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
        body = resp.read()
    root = ET.fromstring(body)
    entries = []
    for item in root.iter("item"):
        entries.append({"title": _text(item, "title"), "link": _text(item, "link")})
        if len(entries) >= limit:
            break
    return entries
